rule: When sending a quote, put a valid-until date of 30 days on the first page.
what_happened: A customer accepted a quote three months after it was sent and expected the old price. Material costs had risen since.
expected: The quote would expire and be re-priced.
why: The quote template had no expiry line.

rule: When a supplier gives a delivery date by phone, ask for it in writing the same day.
what_happened: Asking the supplier to confirm the delivery date by email ended the repeated 'it's coming Friday' calls.
expected: Chasing the supplier by phone each week.
why: A written date gave the supplier something to keep.

rule: When an AI summarises a document, ask it to mark any date it did not find in the text.
what_happened: The meeting summary gave a deadline of 30 September. The transcript never mentioned a date.
expected: The summary would list only dates said in the meeting.
why: The assistant filled a gap with a likely date.

rule: When writing a newsletter, open with the reader's problem before naming the product.
what_happened: The October newsletter was rewritten because it opened with the product and had almost no clicks.
expected: A short product announcement would be enough.
why: Readers skim the first line to decide if it is for them.

rule: When asking an agent for one fix, name the file and say to leave everything else as it is.
what_happened: The agent rebuilt the whole pricing page when asked to fix one typo.
why: The request did not limit what the agent could touch.
tags: agent; scope; one fix; pricing page

rule: When closing the month, collect receipts every Friday, not at month-end.
what_happened: Month-end closed two days sooner once receipts were collected weekly.
expected: Gathering all receipts in the last week.
why: Small weekly batches were checked while memories were fresh.

rule: When a job slips by a day or more, tell the customer before they ask.
what_happened: A customer called the office twice before hearing the cabinets were late. [removed] asked for a discount.
expected: The customer would hear about the delay from us.

rule: When choosing a supplier, score reliability as well as price before deciding.
what_happened: The cheapest supplier missed three of five delivery dates in the first month.
expected: Lower prices with the same service.
why: Price was the only thing compared.

rule: When an AI builds a price table, check that items priced 'on request' are still listed.
what_happened: The assistant left out the three items priced 'on request' from the December price table.
expected: Every item from the list would appear.
why: The items had no number and were treated as empty.
tags: price table; on request; missing items

rule: When handing over a task, include one finished example.
what_happened: The new assistant got the supplier report right the first time once she had last month's report to copy.
why: An example showed the format better than the instructions.

rule: When the website's prices change, update the price page and the quote template together.
what_happened: The website showed new prices while quotes went out at old prices for a week.
expected: Both would change on the same day.
why: They were updated by different people with no shared checklist.

rule: When moving offices, number each box and keep the list with the desk plan.
what_happened: Two boxes of files were unpacked into the wrong room and lost for a week.
expected: Each box would reach its desk.
why: Boxes were labelled by team name only.
